policy_version: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy initial release 2025-07-23; Terms of Use version date 2018-07-13
notes: The public VDP explicitly places GPU memory-isolation and tenant-breakout flaws in scope, treats compliant research as authorized activity, requires use of the researcher's own resources, and requires immediate stop/report on user data. The safe harbor does not extend to third-party upstream infrastructure, so use only resources and reference images within the marketplace scope and do not test a host or data-center directly. Classified full-probe-ok for the bounded GPU-SEAL battery within those limits.
